record.name: Oriole - Text to Speech Reader
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Discover Oriole — an AI-powered text-to-speech tool that swiftly transforms written materials into interactive, engaging audio content in seconds. From academic literature, including textbook readings and papers, to blog articles, technical reports, documents, and more, experience a new way to absorb and work with knowledge! Take your reading on the go or enhance your studying in real-time with AI. 

Oriole is great for creating audible snapshots from any source using intuitive text capture methods. Snap a picture, take a note, upload an article, or use dictation to hear back your thoughts in a different voice.

With Oriole you can:
- Learn faster by listening to a narration of your current reading.
- Get your readings in throughout the day and while on the go by listening to them.
- Increase your comprehension and creativity by using a new AI-powered workflow.
- Get your thoughts down more easily by using dictation.
- Quickly reference key information so you can stay in the flow.

Oriole is your companion for focus and creativity in the digital age.

Turn text to speech and get your reading done in a snap using the camera! You can use Oriole for any type of reading - textbooks, documents, webpage, discussion forums, newspapers, magazines, and printouts! With Oriole, you can use the camera to capture text in any format to generate narration by state-of-the-art AI voices. Oriole facilitates comprehension, retention, and the practical application of key insights from the source, revolutionizing how individuals engage with complex information. 

Your new learning workflow.
- Read in 93 different languages using our multilingual voices, marked with a crown!
- Use your voice to take down your thoughts and ideas, hands-free, then hear it back synthesized using our AI voices.
- Paste long chunks of text from another application on your phone so that you can listen to it instead of needing to read it through.
- Add a link to any webpage that you are reading, whether it be a newspaper, magazine, article, or blog post to get all the text turned into a customized audio program for ease of reading that you can listen to while on the go. During your commute, outside, away from your desk - you can be productive with Oriole.
- Change the speed of the voice to your preference with intuitive speed controls that work for you, not against you, so that you can speed up or slow down at the exact right times. 
- Reference your past snapshots as needed, Oriole remembers where you left off.
- You can have unlimited snapshots in your library and unlock other exclusive features with the Oriole AI premium subscription.

Oriole is a digital assistant that can help you get into the flow of your learning and working. Oriole turns your typed, printed, and spoken text into speech so you can be productive anytime, anywhere. Use Oriole to make progress on your research, studying, project work, and more! Turn text to speech, summarize your reading, and note down thoughts using your voice with Oriole! You can create audible snapshots using multiple sources, so Oriole can unlock workflows to maximize your creativity. With Oriole you can research, read, learn, write, and create in a snap! Get your reading done! Learn faster and more easily!

Do you spend a lot of your time learning or researching? Oriole will summarize long readings for you, so you don't have to spend your time skimming. Instead, get your readings done in less time so you can get your assignments done on time and be ready for your exams. 

Speed up your writing process with Oriole by getting through your references faster, writing your paper in record time, reviewing your drafts by listening to them, and submitting it before the deadline.

Bring Words To Life!

record.description_evidence:
Vizi is your AI vision companion — point, ask, and hear.
Built for blind, low-vision, and colorblind users.
Describe scenes. Read labels. Identify colors. Cross streets with more confidence.

Vizi turns your iPhone's camera into a voice-first assistant. No menus, no typing — just talk naturally and get an instant spoken answer about the world in front of you.

WHAT VIZI DOES

• Describe Your Surroundings — Point the camera and ask "What's in front of me?" for a clear, natural-language description of the scene, people, and objects around you.

• Read Anything Aloud — Mail, menus, medicine labels, signs, screens, handwriting — Vizi reads printed and digital text out loud, instantly.

• Identify Colors — Hold up any object and ask "What color is this?" for a fast, accurate answer.

• Understand Street Crossings — Ask about crosswalks, signals, and curbs to navigate intersections with more confidence.

• Talk Naturally — Ask follow-up questions the way you'd ask a sighted friend. Vizi listens and answers out loud in seconds.

• Built for VoiceOver — Designed with blind and low-vision users from day one. Every screen is fully accessible.

VIZI PLUS

Vizi is free to use every day, with a limited number of questions. For unlimited access, upgrade to Vizi Plus:

• Monthly — $6.99/month
• Yearly — $49.99/year
• Lifetime — $99.99 one-time, pay once

Vizi Plus removes your daily question limit so you can ask Vizi anything, as often as you need to.

ACCESSIBILITY, FIRST

Vizi wasn't retrofitted for accessibility — it was built for it. Every screen works with VoiceOver, every interaction is voice-first, and every answer is spoken clearly, so you can move through your day with less friction and more independence.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS

Vizi Plus is available as an auto-renewing subscription (Monthly, $6.99, or Yearly, $49.99) or as a one-time Lifetime purchase ($99.99). Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, at the price of the selected plan. Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://github.com/pstepanovum/vizi/blob/main/vizi-assets/docs/PRIVACY.md

record.name: Private LLM - Local AI Chat
record.offering: Utilities app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Discover the Ultimate Privacy-Focused AI Assistant on iOS: Private LLM

Unlock a new realm of productivity and creativity on your iPhone and iPad with Private LLM, the premier AI assistant designed with your privacy in mind. Available for a one-time purchase, it offers a range of AI capabilities without needing a subscription. Experience advanced on-device AI that keeps your interactions confidential and offline.

Why Private LLM is Your Go-To AI Companion:

- Exclusive AI Model Selection: Choose from a diverse set of open-source LLM models optimized for performance and perplexity on iOS with state of the art OmniQuant quantization: including models from Llama 2, Llama 3.2, Llama 3.1, Google Gemma 2, Gemma 3, Microsoft Phi-3, Mistral 7B, Qwen 2.5, Qwen 3, StableLM 3B and many more. Whether you need help with creative brainstorming, coding, or daily questions, customize your AI experience to meet your unique needs.

- Integrated with Siri & Shortcuts: Enhance your AI interactions with Siri commands and customizable Shortcuts. Private LLM seamlessly fits within your Apple ecosystem, making your digital assistant more accessible.

- Customizable Interactions: Tailor your AI's responses and interactions with customizable system prompts to match your preferences and needs.

- Uncompromised Privacy and Security: With Private LLM, your conversations stay confidential and on your device. Our advanced on-device AI performs robust computing without risking data compromise or needing an internet connection.

- Family Sharing & Offline Capabilities: Benefit from a one-time purchase that includes Family Sharing. Download models as needed and enjoy the full functionality of your AI assistant, even without internet access.

Supported LLM Model families:
- DeepSeek R1 Distill based models
- Phi 4 based models
- Qwen 3 based models (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507)
- Qwen 2.5 based models (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B and 7B)
- Qwen 2.5 Coder based Models (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B and 14B)
- Llama 3.1 8B based models
- Llama 3.2 1B and 3B based models
- Google Gemma 2 2B and 9B based models
- Google Gemma 3 1B based models
- Mistral 7B based models
- Yi 6B based models

For a full list of supported models, including detailed specifications, please visit privatellm.app/models.

Private LLM is not just a chatbot; it's a comprehensive AI companion designed to respect your privacy while providing versatile, on-demand assistance. Whether you're enhancing your creative writing, tackling complex programming challenges, or just seeking answers, Private LLM adapts to meet your needs while keeping your data secure. Start your journey with Private LLM today and elevate your productivity and creative projects with the most private AI assistant for iOS devices.

Private LLM is a better alternative to generic llama.cpp and MLX wrappers apps like Enchanted, Ollama, LLM Farm, LM Studio, Locally AI, RecurseChat, etc on three fronts: 
1. Private LLM uses a faster and highly-optimized mlc-llm based inference engine.
2. Models in Private LLM are quantized using the state of the art quantization algorithms like OmniQuant, while competing apps use naive round-to-nearest quantization.
3. Private LLM is a fully native app built using C++, Metal and Swift with deep integrations with iOS and iPadOS, while many of the competing apps are bloated and non-native Electron or Flutter based apps.

Please note that Private LLM only supports inference with text based LLMs. Model support varies by device capabilities.

record.description_evidence:
Translate is a fast, private translator for iPhone and iPad. It uses Apple's on-device translation engine, so the words you translate stay on your device, and once a language is downloaded it keeps working with no signal at all.

Type or paste, speak, or hand over a photo or a screenshot. Every way in ends in the same clear translation, ready to read aloud, copy or share.

TYPE OR PASTE
One pane for your words, one for the translation, which appears as you type. Set the source language to Auto-detect and Translate works it out for you.

SPEAK
Tap the microphone and talk. Your words appear as you say them, punctuation included, and the translation keeps up. Speech recognition stays on your device wherever the language supports it.

HEAR IT
Tap the speaker to hear the translation in the best voice installed for the language, or turn on Auto-read and each translation is spoken as it arrives.

PHOTOS AND SCREENSHOTS
Pick a photo, or paste or drop in a screenshot. The text in it is read on your device and translated like anything you type: menus, signs, letters, messages.

HISTORY
Every translation is saved on your device. Search it, copy a line, swipe to delete, or tap one to pick up where you left off.

SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
Say "Translate with Translate", or add the Translate Text action to any shortcut and use the result anywhere, without opening the app.

LANGUAGES
• Every language Apple's on-device engine offers, shown by name and in its own script
• Star your favorites and arrange them in your own order
• Download languages in Settings to use them offline; downloaded ones are marked in the list

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up, no ads, no data collection. Your history stays on your device.

EASY TO READ
• Three text sizes
• Full VoiceOver support, with every control labeled
• Designed for both iPhone and iPad

If hearing loss makes understanding phone calls challenging, try the InnoCaption app for free, fast, and accurate real-time call captions. InnoCaption is available at no cost to eligible users in the United States through funding from the FCC’s Telecommunications Relay Services (TRS) Fund.

**** New Update ****
• Custom Word List – Add custom words like names and specialized terms to improve real-time caption accuracy
• Picture-in-Picture – Keep captions visible in a floating window while using other apps or browsing the web during a call

REAL-TIME CAPTIONS FOR EVERY CALL
• Switch between live stenographers or Automated Speech Recognition (ASR) captions at any time during your call
• Available at no cost to individuals with hearing loss in the United States
• Caption your calls in multiple languages, including Spanish, Chinese, Filipino, and more
• Make and caption 3-way calls

SEAMLESS CALLING & PERSONALIZATION
• Get captions for both incoming and outgoing calls
• Keep your existing phone number with our patented One Number technology
• Use InnoCaption like your regular phone dialer – no need to make calls through a 711 relay
• Customize the InnoCaption app to fit your accessibility needs

TEXT-TO-SPEECH CALLING FEATURES
• Use AI Refine to turn short responses into complete sentences at the touch of a button
• Customize prewritten TTS Shortcuts for fast and effortless replies during calls

ACCESSIBLE TRANSCRIPTS & VOICEMAIL
• Save and view transcripts of previous calls
• Generate concise AI-powered summaries of call transcripts
• Access and read fully captioned voicemail messages

SMART CONTACT INTEGRATION
• Easily sync contacts from your phone to the InnoCaption app
• Continue using your personal cell number by combining our caller ID and call-forwarding features

EMERGENCY CALLS & SPAM FILTER
• Built-in spam call filter blocks high-risk calls and provides notices for potential spam calls
• Make 911 emergency calls with captions*

*911 service may be limited or unavailable in the event of network disruptions or degradation, service connection or internet failure, or other circumstances. For more information, visit www.innocaption.com/calling-911
Cellular data plan or Wi-Fi is required to use the service.

FEDERAL LAW PROHIBITS ANYONE BUT REGISTERED USERS WITH HEARING LOSS FROM USING INTERNET PROTOCOL (IP) CAPTIONED TELEPHONES WITH THE CAPTIONS TURNED ON. IP Captioned Telephone Service may use a live operator. The operator generates captions of what the other party to the call says. These captions are then sent to your phone. There is a cost for each minute of captions generated, paid from a federally administered fund.

For more information, visit us at https://www.innocaption.com
For assistance, contact us at support@innocaption.com

record.description_evidence:
Easy Speak AI is a modern, open-source Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) tool designed to make communication effortless and accessible for everyone.

Whether you need a simple symbol board or a sophisticated sentence builder, Easy Speak AI adapts to your needs. Powered by a lightweight, on-device AI model, it intelligently predicts your next words and expands simple keywords into full, grammatically correct sentences—all without needing an internet connection.

Key Features:

AI Magic Bar: Select a few keywords (e.g., "I", "cookie", "more"), and watch the Magic Bar instantly suggest full sentences like "I would like another cookie, please." It's context-aware, understanding the time of day and your location to give you the most relevant suggestions.

Truly Offline: Built as a Progressive Web App (PWA), Easy Speak AI runs entirely on your device after the first load. No internet? No problem. Communicate anywhere, anytime.

Fully Customizable: Create your own boards, add custom tiles, and organize categories. Import images from the web or use our vast library of symbols powered by OpenSymbols.

Natural Voices: Utilize your device's built-in text-to-speech engines for high-quality, natural-sounding voice output.

Context Awareness: The app smartly adapts its suggestions based on whether you are at home, school, or a restaurant, and whether it's morning or night.

Secure & Private: Your data stays on your device. We use secure local storage and privacy-focused proxies for image searches. No personal conversations are ever sent to the cloud.

Who is this for?

Easy Speak AI is perfect for individuals with speech impairments, autism, aphasia, or anyone who benefits from symbol-based communication. It is also a great tool for speech therapists and caregivers looking for a free, powerful, and customizable AAC solution.

Get started today and find your voice with Easy Speak AI.

Minis — Local-First On-Device AI Agent

Minis is a local-first, on-device AI agent that goes beyond chat. All your data stays on your iPhone — nothing is uploaded to a server by default. Running locally means lower latency and stronger privacy, while the agent still takes real action: browsing the web, accessing your health data, managing your schedule, controlling your smart home, and automating complex tasks.

Local-First AI Agent
Unlike cloud-only chatbots, Minis runs directly on your device and keeps your data there. The agent executes multi-step tasks autonomously, using tools and native iOS frameworks to get things done — not just answer questions, and not just relay everything to the cloud.

Multi-Model, Your Choice
Bring your own API key. Choose from leading AI providers:
• Anthropic Claude
• OpenAI GPT
• Google Gemini
• DeepSeek
• Kimi (Moonshot AI)
• OpenRouter
• Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

Deep iOS Integration
The agent accesses Apple frameworks natively:
• HealthKit — steps, heart rate, sleep, workouts, SpO₂
• Calendar & Reminders — create events, check availability, manage tasks
• HomeKit — control lights, switches, scenes, and smart accessories
• Photos — search, organize, and export from your library
• Location & Maps — current location, directions, nearby POIs
• Vision — OCR text recognition, object detection, barcode scanning
• Speech — real-time transcription and text-to-speech
• Weather — current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts

Built-in Web Browser
Navigate pages, take screenshots, extract content, fill forms, and interact with websites — all driven by the AI agent in the background.

Skills System
Import or create custom AI skills to extend the agent's capabilities. Share skills with others or build your own for specialized workflows.

Persistent Memory
The agent remembers your preferences, project context, and recurring patterns across sessions — building a personalized assistant that improves over time, all stored locally on your device.

Siri Shortcuts
Automate AI tasks with Siri and the Shortcuts app. Send prompts with file attachments, wait for results, and chain into complex workflows — all hands-free.

Privacy by Design
Your API keys and data stay on-device. Fine-grained permission controls let you decide exactly which personal data the agent can access. No account required. No data collected.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Run supported models directly on your device.
• Local conversations and files stay on your device.
• No Noema account is required, and Noema does not collect your data.

• Import PDFs, EPUBs, and textbooks.
• Ask questions and get answers grounded in indexed passages.

• Vision-capable models for image understanding.

record.description_evidence:
PingPath is building a more accessible world. Designed with care for the visually impaired and blind, Ping Path leverages the power of spatial audio, AI, LiDAR technology, and Siri to create an intuitive experience.

Effortless experience: With our innovative path-finding feature, PingPath guides you to avoid obstacles and locate objects. Seamlessly hear objects in rooms, around obstacles, and towards your desired destination, whether you're at home, in the office, or exploring a new place.  This is an early experimental feature that shouldn't be used without someone to assist with navigation.

Siri Integration: PingPath is integrated with Siri for even easier navigation. Just say "Ping Path to the door" or "Hey Siri, PingPath around me" and the app will do the rest.

Spatial Audio: With an added layer of situational awareness, PingPath uses spatial audio to guide you in a natural and intuitive way. Experience your surroundings like never before.

Captioning + Querying: Our captioning feature describes your surroundings, giving you a clearer picture of the world around you. Querying empowers you to ask questions about your environment.

LiDAR Compatibility: Optimized for LiDAR enabled phones, Ping Path offers you detailed and precise navigation. The app also works with standard cameras, ensuring no one is left behind.

At PingPath, we believe in empowering the visually impaired to hear their world with confidence and independence. Join us on this journey and experience the difference today.
